phone.changelog:
• Clinical Heart Rate Zones: 5-zone breakdown (Warm Up, Fat Burn, Aerobic Cardio, Anaerobic, VO2 Peak) with time-in-zone & training effect insights
• Pace-Gradient GPS Route Visualizer: Dynamic speed-dependent Canvas polyline with start/finish pins and km split markers
• Sleep Stages & Daily Readiness Score: Deep, Light, REM, and Awake sleep breakdown, sleep quality index, and 0–100 Daily Readiness gauge with personalized recovery guidance
• Watch Face Creator Studio & 50+ Curated Online Dials with instant 1-tap updates

watch.changelog:
• Super Accurate Step Tracking: Multi-sensor fusion with batch latency tolerance up to 120s for screen-off sleep
• Real-time step detector support and anti-false-positive gait tracker fallback
• User profile-calibrated METs and stride length calculation (height & weight adjusted)
• 5 Native Interactive Watch Faces with touch backlight & theme switching
